metadata.case_name: CHAN KAM FAI v. 李志傑經營之惠林運輸公司

plaintiff.occupation_before: driver and delivery worker for furniture
plaintiff.occupation_after: delivery worker (delivering food and grocery items)

injuries.description: comminuted fracture of the distal phalanx of the left big toe with minimal displacement of the fracture fragments and soft tissues swelling around the fracture
source: the Plaintiff was suffering from comminuted fracture of the distal phalanx of the left big toe with minimal displacement of the fracture fragments and soft tissues swelling around the fracture.
he suffered from capillary and lymphatic injury causing left big toe swelling.
physical examination revealed reduced flexion at the first metatarsal phalangeal joint and total loss of flexion and extension at the interphalangeal joint.

manifestations.description: soft tissues swelling around the fracture
could not bear weight on his left foot and he had to sit on wheelchair for mobilization
on-and-off needle pain and numbness in his left big toe
left big toe will be painful during change of weather and while jumping or running
reduced flexion at the first metatarsal phalangeal joint and total loss of flexion and extension at the interphalangeal joint

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency Department treatment at the Prince of Wales Hospital

losses.description: Pain, stiffness and reduced flexion/extension of the left big toe resulting from fracture and soft tissue injury

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Left big toe is painful while jumping or running; affected ability to carry out such activities
Cannot carry heavy objects like furniture as before, causing a disadvantage and handicap in the labour market

comparable_cases.case_name: Sin Fu Yau v Cheung Kwok Leung Keith & Others
